description: This Java class 'DefaultTbAssetProfileService' implements asset profile management functions such as save, delete, and set default asset profile within the Thingsboard platform, extending an abstract service and utilizing external asset profile services.

classes.name: DefaultTbAssetProfileService
classes.description: Service class for managing asset profiles, including saving, deleting, and setting default profiles, with logging and exception handling.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an AssetProfile, logs the action, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an AssetProfile, logs the action, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: setDefaultAssetProfile
methods.description: Sets an AssetProfile as default, updates previous default if necessary, logs actions, and handles exceptions.
